items.title: Why Trump Won't Fire Lutnick
items.dek: Lutnick is under fire over an Nvidia spy scandal and markets give him 37–45% odds of being out by March 31. Our view: Trump keeps him.
items.call: Lutnick is still Commerce Secretary on March 31, 2027

items.title: Somebody Knew: The Jensen Huang Comeback Bets
items.dek: Brand-new wallets bet on Jensen Huang's return to Nvidia days before anyone said it out loud, at odds of 2 to 6 cents. On the face of the data, someone knew something.
items.call: Polymarket, the CFTC or the DOJ publicly acts on trades in the Huang comeback markets by June 30, 2027
